g.text: Notes
Landside faces are developed along the SFO Museum level-2 outline edges that
face the central garage (lengths [obs]); heights are above the departures
curb, whose own height above the apron is unknown. Photo d1 (Famartin
2025-08-12, CC BY-SA 4.0) is reference only; its ratios are scaled by a person
at the wall (~1.7 m) [inf, low].
T2: nothing about the landside face is dimensioned in any source found; the
elevation records the published description only.
T3 (view 3, review r1-34): heights are the published project levels (CDR 95 %
CD, Oct 2023) above T3 L1 (11'-0"), not above the curb; the project datum is
not printed (L1 ~1-2 ft above the apron if it is ~AMSL [inf]). The facade
bands of T3 West are proportions of the rendered CDR wall section p.23 (no
dimensions printed) [inf, low]; the T3 East landside facade is not described
in any source found [unk]. T3W is under construction 2024-2029 (the May 2026
change adds an airside storey).
